content.user_title: Review Chinese Social Media Drafts Before Publishing
content.value_statement: Chinese social media creators need to identify publishing risks without removing useful detail or personal voice. This skill combines local keyword checks with contextual review, targeted revisions, and reusable personal rules.
actual_capabilities: Run a local Python scanner with 41 built-in patterns, commercial filters, industry filters, and line-level match locations.
Guide contextual reviews for Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and WeChat Channels using bundled rules, source quotations, and platform-specific checklists.
Suggest targeted revisions that preserve meaning, then repeat keyword and contextual checks on the revised draft.
Distinguish documented penalties, missing disclosures, recommendation quality issues, and unknown signals when reviewing publishing problems.
Maintain local profiles, personal rules, wordlists, revision examples, case records, and review history.
Identify unnecessary wording substitutions and keep keyword matches separate from confirmed contextual violations.
limitations: Does not guarantee platform approval, predict recommendation algorithms, or replace professional legal review.
Focuses on Chinese text for three supported platforms; full visual review, livestream checks, and additional platforms remain planned.
Requires Python 3.10 or newer and an AI host with local file and command access for the complete workflow.
The scanner runs locally, but AI processing follows the host's privacy settings; bundled policy references may also become outdated.

use_cases.title: Review a Creator's Spoken Script
use_cases.description: Check a Chinese video script for contextual risks and receive targeted replacements with a platform-specific publishing checklist.

use_cases.title: Check Commercial Campaign Copy
use_cases.description: Review sponsored posts for unsupported claims, missing disclosures, and off-platform calls to action before sending them for approval.

use_cases.title: Investigate a Publishing Penalty
use_cases.description: Compare platform notices with the original content, separate evidence from assumptions, and retain confirmed lessons as personal review rules.

prompt_templates.title: Check a First Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Chinese script for Douyin: [draft]. It is a noncommercial personal post. Identify actual risks, explain uncertain points, and give a publishing checklist.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review one draft for one platform.

prompt_templates.title: Revise a Sponsored Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Chinese sponsored post for Xiaohongshu: [draft]. Preserve my tone, identify required disclosures, suggest replacement sentences, and recheck the revised version.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review and revise commercial content.

prompt_templates.title: Build Personal Review Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Import these terms and explanations as personal review rules: [terms]. Use contextual review unless I explicitly request zero tolerance. Test sample sentences and summarize what changed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: customize future reviews with validated personal rules.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose and Recheck Regulated Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this WeChat Channels notice, Chinese finance draft, and timeline: [evidence]. Separate confirmed causes from uncertainty. Propose compliant revisions, recheck them for Douyin and WeChat Channels, and ask before archiving.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: investigate a penalty and compare revised content across platforms.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: review a Chinese course advertisement for Douyin that guarantees payback within thirty days.
output: Required change: the guaranteed payback claim conflicts with commercial-expression.R03.
Suggested replacement: This course covers practical methods and exercises; individual financial results are not guaranteed.
Next checks: verify supporting claims, confirm commercial disclosures, and recheck the revised Chinese draft.
Boundary: this review does not guarantee platform approval.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: investigate low views on a Douyin post discussing an AI model, with no platform penalty notice.
output: Conclusion: the cause remains unknown; low views alone do not establish a policy violation.
Do not treat the model name as a prohibited term without supporting platform evidence.
Check whether the published images, audio, or video were AI-generated and required a platform disclosure.
Compare titles, covers, originality, posting times, and audience response before drawing a conclusion.
Do not add a permanent personal prohibition based only on this observation.

best_practices: Provide the target platforms, commercial relationship, relevant industry, and complete draft before review.
Verify important policy references and supporting evidence, then recheck every revised draft before publishing.
Redact sensitive information, review the AI host's privacy settings, and decline local archiving when retention is unnecessary.
anti_patterns: Treating a keyword match as a confirmed violation or an empty scan as guaranteed approval.
Requesting misspellings, coded substitutions, or other methods intended to evade moderation.
Turning low views or another account's apparent success into permanent rules without reliable evidence.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The listing supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The complete workflow requires an environment that can read local files and run Python.

faq.question: What dependencies are required?
faq.answer: The scanner requires Python 3.10 or newer and uses only the standard library. Contextual judgment and revisions require the hosting AI assistant.

faq.question: Which platforms and content types are covered?
faq.answer: It focuses on Chinese scripts, articles, captions, titles, and post text for Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and WeChat Channels. Image checks are best effort.

faq.question: Does a clean result guarantee approval?
faq.answer: No. Keyword checks only locate candidates, and contextual review cannot predict hidden platform decisions. Important legal or regulated claims still need qualified review.

faq.question: Where are drafts and review records processed?
faq.answer: The scanner reads locally, and review records are stored locally unless you decline archiving. AI processing may send content to your chosen provider.

faq.question: Can I add personal terms or exceptions?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports wordlists, personal rules, and contextual exceptions. These can reduce keyword false positives but cannot override legal or platform requirements.
